defective_pattern: Guessing or assuming reversed questionnaire items without validating against official psychometric scoring keys in Questionnaires.xlsx.
why_defective: Produces corrupted composite scores, attenuated correlation coefficients, and negative factor loadings in CFA.
observed_symptoms: Negative item-total correlations on intended positive subscales
Reversed items chosen via text guessing rather than psychometric key
corrective_remedy: Query psychometric-scale-resolver or Questionnaires.xlsx to extract the exact inverted item list for the target questionnaire before aggregation.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Reverse coding script executed without referencing verified scale_spec or Questionnaires.xlsx.
